title: Drop and Ghost
author: Yara Reyes
blurb: Wendell Sandoval, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
